# UNIT. SPACE CITY

> Three UNIT.SPACE residential complexes next to Nuanu, Bali: 105 villas and studios, three minutes to the ocean, rental yield from 10% a year. Direct from the developer, UNIT.SPACE.

Three residential complexes on Jalan Pantai Nyanyi, Beraban, Tabanan, Bali, next to Nuanu Creative City and 3 minutes from Nyanyi beach: U1 Space Village (completed 2024), U2 Nuanu Village (completed 2026) and U3 Nyanyi Village (under construction). Developer: UNIT (https://unitdeveloper.com/). Prices are shown in IDR by default, the header has a currency switch. The site is available in 9 languages: en, ru, id, fr, es, uk, it, tr, nl; English is at the root, other languages under /<code>/.
